title: Shortcuts Reference
description: Complete keyboard and mouse shortcuts for the Lupis Engine editor. Use this reference to speed up navigation, scene editing, tile painting, shape drawing, and visual scripting.

blocks.content: Keyboard and mouse shortcuts let you navigate canvases, switch tools, and edit items across the [Editor Overview](interface/editor_overview). Shortcuts are grouped below by the panel or workspace tab where they are active.

blocks.message: Single-key tool shortcuts (such as **V**, **B**, or **E**) are disabled while you are typing inside a text input or number field.

blocks.content: These shortcuts work across the entire editor.

items.description: Save the project
Undo the last action
Redo the last undone action
Redo (alternative)
Toggle the debug mini console during preview
Clear selection in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) or close an open modal

blocks.content: Use these shortcuts to control the camera and transform entities in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport) and UI editor.

items.description: Pan the viewport camera (hold **Space** and drag)
Zoom in or out toward the pointer
Fast zoom at 2x speed
Scroll the camera vertically
Scroll the camera horizontally
Select root entity (or drag on empty space to box-select)
Select a nested child entity directly
Add or remove an entity from the selection
Lock aspect ratio while dragging a resize handle
Invert grid and smart-guide snapping while dragging
Open the entity or canvas context menu

blocks.content: Use these shortcuts in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy), the clip list in the [Sprite Animator](components/sprite_animator), and the **Assets**, **Prefabs**, and **Scripts** panels in the bottom dock.

items.description: Copy the selected entity, layer, clip, or dock item
Cut the selected item
Paste the clipboard item into the active layer or folder
Duplicate the selected entity, layer, or animation clip
Rename the selected entity, layer, or dock item
Delete the selected item
Refresh the active bottom dock panel

blocks.content: These shortcuts are active when editing a [Tilemap](components/renderers/tilemap) in the **Tilemap Editor** tab.

items.description: Select tool (box-select and move tiles)
Brush tool (paint tiles)
Eraser tool (erase tiles)
Bucket tool (flood fill contiguous area)
Eyedropper tool (pick tile under pointer)
Hold to pan the tilemap canvas
Drag to box-select tiles without switching from the brush
Clear all tiles inside the active selection

blocks.content: These shortcuts are active when drawing or editing geometry for a [Shape Renderer](components/renderers/shape_renderer) in the **Shape Editor** tab.

blocks.content: Use these shortcuts in the [visual scripting](visual_scripting/graph_concepts) graph canvas and the [Custom Node & Code Panel](visual_scripting/custom_node_and_code).

Save and compile JavaScript in the Code Panel
